questions.q: What is the primary objective of the India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (FTA)?
options: To reduce unemployment in both countries
To double bilateral trade to USD 5 billion
To promote tourism between the two nations
questions.explain: 💰 The FTA aims to double bilateral trade to USD 5 billion within five years, showcasing a strong economic partnership! 🌏✨ This means both countries can benefit from enhanced market access and long-term investments! 📈💼

questions.q: What has prompted China to resume imports of broken rice from India?
options: Ban on rice imports from other countries
Increase in agricultural production in India
questions.explain: 📈 China's renewed trade with India is driven by the competitive pricing of Indian broken rice, which is around $300–310 per tonne! 🚢 With rising logistical costs and geopolitical tensions, India’s prices remain attractive compared to Thailand and Vietnam. 🥇 Remember, pricing plays a crucial role in international trade!
